summary: Frontend-only test of TinyNinja jumper. Home screen, Settings modal, PLAY navigation, HUD elements, Pause overlay + resume + home-from-pause all render correctly with correct testIDs. CRITICAL BUG: Game loop appears to not progress on web preview - score-value stays at 0 for 40+ seconds, ninja is NOT rendered on-screen, and game-over never triggers naturally. Only two of three toggle groups (haptics + control mode) persist. Also detected React Native Web deprecation warnings (props.pointerEvents, shadow*). Deprecated packages detected: none (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch not used). Missing tests: could not naturally reach Game Over so retry/home buttons on game-over overlay verified only for existence at DOM registration - not runtime because overlay never appeared.

ui_bugs.issue: Score never increases and ninja is not visible on screen. Waited 40+ seconds on /game with no touch input: score-value remained '0' for the entire duration and no game-over-overlay ever appeared. Screenshots show platforms/coins rendered but the Ninja sprite is missing entirely. Suggests either (a) raf loop stops after a few frames, (b) setState in loop is not causing a re-render of entity positions, or (c) initial ninja x/y is off-screen (Dimensions on web might mismatch), preventing climb increments. Reference: /app/frontend/app/game.tsx lines 47, 75-97 (loop uses stateRef mutation + setTick) and /app/frontend/src/game/engine.ts:159 (getScore).

NinjaView is not visible in the /game viewport during the whole run. Since state uses stateRef.current (mutation) and children read s.ninja.x/y on each setTick, if setTick doesn't force enough re-renders or ninja is placed at bad coords, it never appears. Reference: /app/frontend/app/game.tsx:195-201.

integration_issues.issue: Because game never dies naturally (see game-loop bug), Best score never increments from 0 and total coins never increment. On-device persistence flow (KEY_BEST/KEY_COINS via storage) could not be validated end-to-end.

issues: A platform overlaps the pause-button at top-left when it spawns near the top of the viewport (visible in screenshots). Consider constraining spawn X to avoid the HUD zone or elevating HUD z-index above entity layer (entity layer is drawn before HUD in JSX, so this should be fine, but rendering shows overlap because they share space).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Two Views set pointerEvents as a prop. Reference: /app/frontend/app/game.tsx:182 and /app/frontend/app/game.tsx:224 (and possibly :239).

React Native Web warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Fired by several styled elements using shadow.card / shadow.soft. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme (shadow tokens applied in app/index.tsx:214, app/game.tsx (hudBtn, coinHud, card)).

action_items: CRITICAL: Debug why score-value stays 0 and ninja does not render on web. Suggested checks: (1) log s.ninja.x/y and s.climb inside loop; (2) verify Dimensions.get('window') returns non-zero W/H before createGame() executes (currently W/H are captured at module load — replace with useWindowDimensions or lazy initialisation inside useEffect); (3) confirm the raf loop still runs after first frame (StrictMode double-mount may call stopLoop leaving runningRef=false — startLoop guard is only against re-entry, but if a cleanup calls stopLoop after start, the loop stops). Consider re-initialising stateRef and starting loop inside a useEffect that runs after layout.
Fix persistence-related side-effects blocked by the loop bug — retest end-to-end once loop runs.
Migrate `pointerEvents` prop usages to `style.pointerEvents` in game.tsx.
Migrate `shadow*` style tokens to `boxShadow` in the theme (or provide platform-conditional style) to remove RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: game.tsx: Dimensions.get('window') is called at module scope; on RN Web the reported dimensions may not reflect the actual viewport when the component mounts inside the preview iframe. Use useWindowDimensions() and create the game state inside useEffect after loaded=true.

game.tsx useEffect at line 112: dependency is only [loaded] but startLoop/stopLoop are useCallback-created; the ESLint suppression could hide a stale-closure bug where a StrictMode double-invocation cancels the freshly started raf. Guard startLoop so it doesn't double-start AND make stopLoop idempotent (already ok), but ensure cleanup order works with StrictMode.
engine.ts step(): coin/powerup collision uses NINJA_W*0.35 hitbox — fine, but coin hit test still passes when ninja not yet moved; acceptable.
index.tsx line 32: HOME_BG uses a remote Unsplash URL — offline first launch will show blank background; consider bundling a local asset.
SettingsSheet.tsx: no unmount animation persistence issue observed, but Modal doesn't set statusBarTranslucent for Android — minor.

Once that works, verify natural game-over -> retry (game-screen appears again with score=0) -> home flow, and confirm Best/Coins on Home update after a run. rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open https://mobile-app-clone-24.preview.emergentagent.com/game in a 375x667 viewport with no interaction. Expected: score-value increments as the ninja bounces & camera scrolls (climb / 10). Observed: score-value stays 0 for 40+ seconds; no NinjaView pixels are visible in screenshots though platforms and coins render. Most likely causes (in priority order): (1) Dimensions.get('window') returns stale/zero size at module load causing createGame(W,H) to place ninja off-screen; (2) React 18 StrictMode double-invokes the boot useEffect and the cleanup stopLoop cancels the loop scheduled by the second startLoop; (3) setTick re-render is starving because the callback identity of loop depends on persist which may change. Mitigation: (a) create GameState lazily inside useEffect once dimensions are known via useWindowDimensions(); (b) make the boot effect resilient to StrictMode by using a mounted flag and only stopping the loop on final unmount; (c) call cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current) before starting a new one in startLoop for extra safety.
